description: Cases for verifying. `storedText` is the file before (null: no file). When a case has `config`, it is the text of config.json in the contracts directory. Verify `observed` as `kind` (provider: verifyResponse on the provider side; consumer: verifyRequest on the consumer side) with update mode on or off. `outcome` is ok, written, mismatch, missing, invalid-stored, invalid-observed, refused (update mode would drop a secret path), invalid-config (config.json does not follow the format; `issues` are its issues) or usage. `differences` are the lines of a mismatch. `written` is the file text afterwards when the file must have been (re)written, null when it must be unchanged. A ledger line is appended exactly when the outcome is ok or written. `observed` may carry `secret`, and `volatile` entries with a pattern (and `nullable`). `message` is the whole message of the error, character for character. `warnings` are the notes the verify gives without failing (to standard error, by default), word for word; a case without the key gives none. `issues` are the codes and paths of what an invalid-observed or refused outcome reports, in order. When a case has `absent`, none of those strings may appear in the message of the error, in any file under the contracts directory, or in the ledger afterwards.
